purpose: Teach: 念願/恐い/只今/ナイフ/マナー/水曜日/金持ち/ウソ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お祖父さまの、本気で、絶対、念願、絶対、の、絶対、お店、絶対、葵、絶対、頑張ってるね
lines.en: Aoi, your grandfather's dream café — you're really putting in the work.
lines.style: Warm, observant admiration. Slow pace, landing on each element. Voice soft but clear. Genuine recognition without fanfare.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、夜道は、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、恐い、絶対、よ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. But the nights walking home get a little scary, you know?
lines.style: Light, self-deprecating. Quick delivery with a slight smile in the voice. Acknowledging the concern without making it heavy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、只今、絶対、ご注文承りますって、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、丁寧な接客よね
lines.en: And your service is so considerate — the way you greet people, 'We're ready to take your order.' So polite.
lines.style: Admiring, attentive to detail. Voice lingers on the praise. Gentle emphasis on the formality. Noticing what others might miss.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお店の、本気で、絶対、ナイフ、絶対、切れ味、絶対、いいよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The equipment is good too — sharp knives, everything in its place.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact approval. Practical eye for what works. Steady, grounded tone. Speaking from observation, not flattery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、マナー、絶対、よい、絶対、お客様、絶対、多いわよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Your customers are good people. You welcome everyone warmly, whether they're wealthy or not. It's something to admire.
lines.style: Thoughtful, sincere. Pause before the final thought. Voice carries respect for the principle beneath the action. No performative tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、水曜日、絶対、定休日、絶対、にしてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You keep Wednesday closed so you can rest — that shows you care about yourself too.
lines.style: Practical observation delivered with quiet approval. Even pace. Recognition of the wisdom in the choice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、金持ち、絶対、ではない、絶対、お客様も、絶対、暖かく、絶対、迎えてるよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: And you never lie to your customers. That kind of integrity in a small business — it's really something.
lines.style: Tender, sincere. Slower pace on the closing thought. Voice carries weight and warmth. Deep recognition of character.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様に、絶対、ウソ、絶対、つかない、絶対、商売、絶対、心がけてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That's the heart of what you're doing — honesty. That matters more than anything else.
lines.style: Earnest and close. Quiet conviction. Voice softens at the end. Speaking from the heart, not performing appreciation.
